map.基于 Archard 磨损方程，计算材料在滑动摩擦条件下的磨损率和耐磨等级: Based on the Archard wear equation, compute the wear rate and wear-resistance grade of a material under sliding friction
map.磨损系数 k ≈ a·μ²（摩擦越大磨损越剧烈的经验简化式）: Wear coefficient k is approximately a times mu squared (the empirical simplification that greater friction means more severe wear)
map.由材料硬度、摩擦系数、接触压力与滑动速度，依据磨损系数与摩擦系数关联的经验简化式: From material hardness, friction coefficient, contact pressure and sliding velocity, comprehensively assess wear resistance by the empirical simplification relating wear coefficient and friction coefficient.
map.💡 Archard 方程：比磨损率 Ws = K ÷ H；磨损深度率 wd =: Archard equation: specific wear rate Ws = K divided by H; wear depth rate wd = Ws times P times v (K is wear coefficient, H is hardness MPa, P is contact pressure, v is sliding velocity)
map.HRC 硬度自动转换为维氏硬度(HV)再换算为 MPa：H(MPa) = 9.8: HRC hardness is auto-converted to Vickers hardness (HV) then to MPa: H(MPa) = 9.81 times HV
map.磨损系数 K 按经验公式估算：K ≈ 1×10⁻⁴ × μ²（μ 为摩擦系数）: Wear coefficient K is estimated by empirical formula: K is approximately 1e-4 times mu squared (mu is friction coefficient)

map.磨损量预算：算 1000 小时磨损深度，判断是否需要改进: Wear amount budgeting: compute 1000-hour wear depth and judge whether improvement is needed
map.工况优化：评估降低接触压力或滑动速度的效果: Condition optimization: evaluate the effect of reducing contact pressure or sliding velocity
map.算法：按 Archard 方程，先由 HRC 查表线性插值换算 HV（20HRC: Algorithm: by Archard equation, first convert HRC to HV by table linear interpolation (20 HRC = 226 HV, 40 HRC = 372 HV, 55 HRC = 560 HV, 68 HRC = 940 HV), hardness H = HV times 9.81 (MPa); wear coefficient K = 1e-4 times mu squared; specific wear rate Ws = K / H (mm3 / N m); wear depth rate = Ws times contact pressure times sliding velocity (mm/s), times 3600 gives mm/h, times 1000 gives 1000 h depth. Grade by Ws: less than 1e-6 A, less than 1e-5 B, less than 1e-4 C, less than 1e-3 D, otherwise E; and prompt by 1000 h depth (greater than or equal to 1 mm warning, greater than or equal to 0.1 mm needs attention).
map.例：55HRC（换算 560HV、H=5494MPa）、μ=0.3、接触压力 5: Example: 55 HRC (convert 560 HV, H = 5494 MPa), mu = 0.3, contact pressure 5 MPa, sliding velocity 1 m/s gives K = 9.0e-6, Ws = 1.64e-9 mm3 / N m (grade A), wear depth rate 8.19e-9 mm/s, 1000 h only 0.0295 mm, judged as excellent wear resistance. If dropped to 20 HRC (226 HV, H = 2217 MPa), mu = 0.6, pressure 20 MPa, velocity 2 m/s gives K = 3.6e-5, Ws = 1.62e-8, 1000 h depth reaches 2.34 mm, triggering severe wear warning.
map.为什么算出来几乎都是 A 级？: Why is almost everything computed as grade A?
map.Ws 的量级约 1e-9~1e-8 mm³/N·m，远低于 1e-6 的 A 级: The Ws magnitude is about 1e-9 to 1e-8 mm3 / N m, far below the 1e-6 grade A threshold, so the grade discrimination is very low. For actual judgment, focus on the 1000-hour wear depth engineering metric (greater than or equal to 1 mm warning, greater than or equal to 0.1 mm needs attention).
map.K = 1e-4×μ² 是什么依据？: What is the basis of K = 1e-4 times mu squared?
map.是把摩擦系数与磨损系数关联的经验简化式，用来体现\"摩擦越大磨损越剧烈\"的平方: It is an empirical simplification relating friction coefficient and wear coefficient, to reflect the squared relationship that greater friction means more severe wear. The real K should be determined by pin-disk wear tests and distinguish material pairing and lubrication state.
